verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָשֶׁ֙בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְיָרָבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ עֲזַרְיָ֥ה בֶן־ אֲמַצְיָ֖ה מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ ‘eś·rîm wā·še·ḇa‘ šā·nāh lə·yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl mā·laḵ ‘ă·zar·yāh ḇen- ’ă·maṣ·yāh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the twenty-seventh . . . . . . year of Jeroboam’s reign over Israel Azariah son of Amaziah became king . . . of Judah
verses.literalPt: No ano vinte e sete de Jeroboão, rei de Israel, começou a reinar Azarias, filho de Amazias, rei de Judá.

verses.original: בֶּן־ שֵׁ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְכָלְיָ֖הוּ מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- šêš ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh hā·yāh ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw yə·ḵā·lə·yā·hū mî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: He was sixteen . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two . . . years His mother’s name was Jecoliah she was from Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Tinha dezesseis anos quando começou a reinar e reinou cinquenta e dois anos em Jerusalém. Sua mãe chamava-se Jecolias, de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD just as his father Amaziah had done
verses.literalPt: Ele fez o que era reto aos olhos de Jeová, conforme tudo o que fizera Amazias, seu pai.

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־ סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָעָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: raq hab·bā·mō·wṯ lō- sā·rū ‘ō·wḏ hā·‘ām mə·zab·bə·ḥîm ū·mə·qaṭ·ṭə·rîm bab·bā·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Nevertheless the high places were not taken away the people continued sacrificing and burning incense there
verses.literalPt: Contudo, os altos não foram tirados; o povo ainda oferecia sacrifícios e queimava incenso nos altos.

verses.original: וַיְנַגַּ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיְהִ֤י מְצֹרָע֙ עַד־ י֣וֹם מֹת֔וֹ וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּבֵ֣ית הַחָפְשִׁ֑ית וְיוֹתָ֤ם בֶּן־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ הַבַּ֔יִת שֹׁפֵ֖ט אֶת־ עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·nag·ga‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ way·hî mə·ṣō·rā‘ ‘aḏ- yō·wm mō·ṯōw way·yê·šeḇ bə·ḇêṯ ha·ḥā·p̄ə·šîṯ wə·yō·w·ṯām ben- ham·me·leḵ ‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ šō·p̄êṭ ’eṯ- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And the LORD afflicted the king . . . with leprosy until the day he died so that he lived in a separate house while his son Jotham had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land
verses.literalPt: Jeová feriu o rei, de modo que ficou leproso até o dia da sua morte e habitou numa casa separada. Jotão, filho do rei, tinha o cargo da casa, julgando o povo da terra.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י עֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ‘ă·zar·yā·hū wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Azariah along with all his accomplishments . . . . . . . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Azarias e tudo o que ele fez não estão, porventura, escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Judá?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עֲזַרְיָה֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ ‘ă·zar·yāh ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·‘îr dā·wiḏ way·yim·lōḵ yō·w·ṯām bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Azariah rested with his fathers and was buried near them in the City of David And his son Jotham reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Adormeceu Azarias com seus pais, e sepultaram-no com eles na Cidade de Davi. Em seu lugar, reinou seu filho Jotão.

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּשְׁמֹנֶה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ זְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יָרָבְעָ֧ם עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן שִׁשָּׁ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·mō·neh šā·nāh la·‘ă·zar·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mā·laḵ zə·ḵar·yā·hū ḇen- yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn šiš·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: In the thirty-eighth . . . . . . year of Azariah’s reign over Judah Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel and he reigned in Samaria six months
verses.literalPt: No ano trinta e oito de Azarias, rei de Judá, reinou Zacarias, filho de Jeroboão, sobre Israel, em Samaria, seis meses.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָ֑יו לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵֽחַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śū ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw lō sār mê·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD as his fathers had done He did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit
verses.literalPt: Ele fez o mal à vista de Jeová, como tinham feito seus pais; não se apartou dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com os quais este fez pecar a Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּקְשֹׁ֤ר עָלָיו֙ שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן־ יָבֵ֔שׁ וַיַּכֵּ֥הוּ קָֽבָלְ־ עָ֖ם וַיְמִיתֵ֑הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·šōr ‘ā·lāw šal·lum ben- yā·ḇêš way·yak·kê·hū qā·ḇā·lə·‘ām ‘am way·mî·ṯê·hū way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Then Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah struck him down and killed him in front of the people and reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Salum, filho de Jabes, conspirou contra ele; feriu-o diante do povo, matou-o e reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וְיֶ֖תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י זְכַרְיָ֑ה הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê zə·ḵar·yāh hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Zechariah they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Zacarias, eis que está escrito no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel.

verses.original: ה֣וּא דְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר אֶל־ יֵהוּא֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בְּנֵ֣י רְבִיעִ֔ים יֵשְׁב֥וּ לְךָ֖ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: hū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber ’el- yê·hū lê·mōr bə·nê rə·ḇî·‘îm yê·šə·ḇū lə·ḵā ‘al- kis·sê yiś·rā·’êl way·hî- ḵên
verses.literal: So the word of the LORD spoken to Jehu . . . was fulfilled Four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel
verses.literalPt: Esta foi a palavra que Jeová falou a Jeú: Teus filhos até a quarta geração se assentarão sobre o trono de Israel. Assim sucedeu.

verses.original: שַׁלּ֤וּם בֶּן־ יָבֵישׁ֙ מָלַ֔ךְ בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָתֵ֙שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְעֻזִיָּ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ יֶֽרַח־ יָמִ֖ים בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: šal·lūm ben- yā·ḇêš mā·laḵ biš·naṯ šə·lō·šîm wā·ṯê·ša‘ šā·nāh lə·‘u·zî·yāh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh way·yim·lōḵ ye·raḥ- yā·mîm bə·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: In the thirty-ninth . . . . . . year of Uzziah’s reign over Judah Shallum son of Jabesh became king and he reigned in Samaria one full month . . .
verses.literalPt: Salum, filho de Jabes, começou a reinar no ano trinta e nove de Uzias, rei de Judá, e reinou pelo espaço de um mês em Samaria.

verses.original: וַיַּעַל֩ מְנַחֵ֨ם בֶּן־ גָּדִ֜י מִתִּרְצָ֗ה וַיָּבֹא֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וַיַּ֛ךְ אֶת־ שַׁלּ֥וּם בֶּן־ יָבֵ֖ישׁ בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיְמִיתֵ֖הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al mə·na·ḥêm ben- gā·ḏî mit·tir·ṣāh way·yā·ḇō šō·mə·rō·wn way·yaḵ ’eṯ- šal·lūm ben- yā·ḇêš bə·šō·mə·rō·wn way·mî·ṯê·hū way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Then Menahem son of Gadi went up from Tirzah . . . to Samaria struck down and killed Shallum son of Jabesh and reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Subiu de Tirza Menaém, filho de Gadi, e veio a Samaria, onde feriu a Salum, filho de Jabes, e o matou, e reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י שַׁלּ֔וּם וְקִשְׁר֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָשָׁ֑ר הִנָּ֣ם כְּתֻבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê šal·lūm wə·qiš·rōw ’ă·šer qā·šār hin·nām kə·ṯu·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Shallum along with the conspiracy he led they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Salum e a conspiração que fez, eis que estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יַכֶּֽה־ מְ֠נַחֵם אֶת־ תִּפְסַ֨ח וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֤הּ וְאֶת־ גְּבוּלֶ֙יהָ֙ מִתִּרְצָ֔ה כִּ֛י לֹ֥א פָתַ֖ח וַיַּ֑ךְ אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הֶהָ֥רוֹתֶ֖יהָ בִּקֵּֽעַ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’āz yak·keh- mə·na·ḥêm ’eṯ- tip̄·saḥ wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- bāh wə·’eṯ- gə·ḇū·le·hā mit·tir·ṣāh kî lō p̄ā·ṯaḥ way·yaḵ ’êṯ kāl- he·hā·rō·w·ṯe·hā biq·qê·a‘
verses.literal: At that time Menahem starting from Tirzah attacked Tiphsah and everyone in its vicinity because they would not open their gates So he attacked Tiphsah and ripped open all the pregnant women
verses.literalPt: Então, Menaém feriu a Tifsa com todos os que nela estavam e a seus termos, desde Tirza. Porque não lhe abriram as portas, por isso a feriu; e rasgou pelo ventre todas as mulheres grávidas que nela estavam.

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָתֵ֙שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ מְנַחֵ֨ם בֶּן־ גָּדִ֧י עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִ֖ים בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šə·lō·šîm wā·ṯê·ša‘ šā·nāh la·‘ă·zar·yāh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mā·laḵ mə·na·ḥêm ben- gā·ḏî ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ‘e·śer šā·nîm bə·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: In the thirty-ninth . . . year of Azariah’s reign over Judah Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel and he reigned in Samaria ten years
verses.literalPt: No ano trinta e nove de Azarias, rei de Judá, começou Menaém, filho de Gadi, a reinar sobre Israel e reinou dez anos em Samaria.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֠ר מֵעַ֨ל חַטֹּ֜אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל־ יָמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lō sār mê·‘al ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer- he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl kāl- yā·māw
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and throughout his reign he did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit
verses.literalPt: Ele fez o mal à vista de Jeová; não se apartou todos os seus dias dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com os quais este fez pecar a Israel.

verses.original: בָּ֣א פ֤וּל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיִּתֵּ֤ן מְנַחֵם֙ לְפ֔וּל אֶ֖לֶף כִּכַּר־ כָּ֑סֶף לִהְי֤וֹת יָדָיו֙ אִתּ֔וֹ לְהַחֲזִ֥יק הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā p̄ūl me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ way·yit·tên mə·na·ḥêm lə·p̄ūl ’e·lep̄ kik·kar- kā·sep̄ lih·yō·wṯ yā·ḏāw ’it·tōw lə·ha·ḥă·zîq ham·mam·lā·ḵāh bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded . . . the land and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver in order to gain his support . . . . . . and strengthen his own grip on the kingdom
verses.literalPt: Pul, rei da Assíria, veio contra a terra; e Menaém deu a Pul mil talentos de prata, para que este o socorresse, a fim de confirmar-lhe o reino na sua mão.

verses.original: וַיֹּצֵא֩ מְנַחֵ֨ם אֶת־ הַכֶּ֜סֶף עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל כָּל־ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֔יִל לָתֵת֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר חֲמִשִּׁ֧ים שְׁקָלִ֛ים כֶּ֖סֶף לְאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְלֹא־ עָ֥מַד שָׁ֖ם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ṣê mə·na·ḥêm ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al kāl- gib·bō·w·rê ha·ḥa·yil lā·ṯêṯ lə·me·leḵ ’aš·šūr ḥă·miš·šîm šə·qā·lîm ke·sep̄ lə·’îš ’e·ḥāḏ way·yā·šāḇ me·leḵ ’aš·šūr wə·lō- ‘ā·maḏ šām bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Menahem exacted this money from . . . each of the wealthy men of Israel fifty shekels of silver from each man to give to the king of Assyria So the king of Assyria withdrew and did not remain . . . in the land
verses.literalPt: Menaém exigiu o dinheiro de todos os poderosos e ricos em Israel, cinquenta siclos de prata por cabeça, para o dar ao rei da Assíria. Voltou o rei da Assíria e não se demorou ali na terra.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י מְנַחֵ֖ם וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê mə·na·ḥêm wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Menahem along with all his accomplishments . . . . . . . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Menaém e tudo o que ele fez não estão, porventura, escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב מְנַחֵ֖ם עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ פְּקַחְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ mə·na·ḥêm ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yim·lōḵ pə·qaḥ·yāh ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Menahem rested with his fathers and his son Pekahiah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Adormeceu Menaém com seus pais. Em seu lugar, reinou seu filho Pecaías.

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַת֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ פְּקַֽחְיָ֨ה בֶן־ מְנַחֵ֧ם עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן שְׁנָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ ḥă·miš·šîm šā·nāh la·‘ă·zar·yāh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mā·laḵ pə·qaḥ·yāh ḇen- mə·na·ḥêm ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn šə·nā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: In the fiftieth year of Azariah’s reign over Judah Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel and reigned in Samaria two years
verses.literalPt: No ano cinquenta de Azarias, rei de Judá, começou Pecaías, filho de Menaém, a reinar sobre Israel, em Samaria, e reinou dois anos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵֽחַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lō sār mê·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit
verses.literalPt: Ele fez o mal à vista de Jeová; não se apartou dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com os quais este fez pecar a Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּקְשֹׁ֣ר עָלָיו֩ פֶּ֨קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֜הוּ שָׁלִישׁ֗וֹ וַיַּכֵּ֨הוּ בְשֹׁמְר֜וֹן בְּאַרְמ֤וֹן בֵּית־ מֶלֶךְ אֶת־ אַרְגֹּ֣ב וְאֶת־ הָאַרְיֵ֔ה וְעִמּ֛וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָדִ֑ים וַיְמִיתֵ֖הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·šōr ‘ā·lāw pe·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū šā·lî·šōw way·yak·kê·hū ḇə·šō·mə·rō·wn bə·’ar·mō·wn bêṯ- mɛ·lɛḵ ’eṯ- ’ar·gōḇ wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·yêh wə·‘im·mōw ḥă·miš·šîm ’îš mib·bə·nê ḡil·‘ā·ḏîm way·mî·ṯê·hū way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Then his officer Pekah son of Remaliah conspired against him along with Argob . . . Arieh and fifty men of Gilead And at the citadel of the king’s palace in Samaria Pekah struck down and killed Pekahiah and reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Peca, seu capitão, filho de Remalias, fez uma conspiração contra ele, e feriu-o em Samaria, no castelo da casa do rei, juntamente com Argobe e Arié (e com Peca estavam cinquenta homens dos gileaditas), e matou-o, e reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י פְקַחְיָ֖ה וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê p̄ə·qaḥ·yāh wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Pekahiah along with all his accomplishments . . . they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Pecaías e tudo o que ele fez, eis que estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel.

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ פֶּ֣קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֧הוּ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ ḥă·miš·šîm ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nāh la·‘ă·zar·yāh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mā·laḵ pe·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh
verses.literal: In the fifty-second . . . year of Azariah’s reign over Judah Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel and he reigned in Samaria twenty years
verses.literalPt: No ano cinquenta e dois de Azarias, rei de Judá, começou Peca, filho de Remalias, a reinar sobre Israel, em Samaria, e reinou vinte anos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִן־ חַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lō sār min- ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit
verses.literalPt: Ele fez o mal à vista de Jeová; não se apartou dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com os quais este fez pecar a Israel.

verses.original: בִּימֵ֞י פֶּ֣קַח מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בָּא֮ תִּגְלַ֣ת פִּלְאֶסֶר֮ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֒ וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ עִיּ֡וֹן וְאֶת־ אָבֵ֣ל בֵּֽית־ מַעֲכָ֡ה וְאֶת־ יָ֠נוֹחַ וְאֶת־ קֶ֨דֶשׁ וְאֶת־ חָצ֤וֹר וְאֶת־ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְאֶת־ הַגָּלִ֔ילָה כֹּ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ נַפְתָּלִ֑י וַיַּגְלֵ֖ם אַשּֽׁוּרָה׃
verses.transliteration: bî·mê pe·qaḥ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl bā tiḡ·laṯ pil·’e·ser me·leḵ ’aš·šūr way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ‘î·yō·wn wə·’eṯ- ’ā·ḇêl bêṯ- ma·‘ă·ḵāh wə·’eṯ- yā·nō·w·aḥ wə·’eṯ- qe·ḏeš wə·’eṯ- ḥā·ṣō·wr wə·’eṯ- hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·’eṯ- hag·gā·lî·lāh kōl ’e·reṣ nap̄·tā·lî way·yaḡ·lêm ’aš·šū·rāh
verses.literal: In the days of Pekah king of Israel Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came and captured Ijon Abel-beth-maacah Janoah Kedesh Hazor Gilead and Galilee including all the land of Naphtali and he took the people as captives to Assyria
verses.literalPt: Nos dias de Peca, rei de Israel, veio Tiglate-Pileser, rei da Assíria, e tomou a Ijom, a Abel-Bete-Maaca, a Janoa, a Quedes, a Hazor, a Gileade e a Galileia, toda a terra de Naftali; e levou os habitantes cativos para a Assíria.

verses.original: וַיִּקְשָׁר־ קֶ֜שֶׁר הוֹשֵׁ֣עַ בֶּן־ אֵלָ֗ה עַל־ פֶּ֙קַח֙ בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֔הוּ וַיַּכֵּ֙הוּ֙ וַיְמִיתֵ֔הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּ֑יו בִּשְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְיוֹתָ֖ם בֶּן־ עֻזִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·šār- qe·šer hō·wō·šê·a‘ ben- ’ê·lāh ‘al- pe·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū way·yak·kê·hū way·mî·ṯê·hū way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw biš·naṯ ‘eś·rîm lə·yō·w·ṯām ben- ‘u·zî·yāh
verses.literal: Then Hoshea son of Elah led a conspiracy against Pekah son of Remaliah In the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah Hoshea attacked Pekah killed him and reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Oseias, filho de Elá, fez uma conspiração contra Peca, filho de Remalias, e feriu-o, e matou-o, e reinou no seu lugar, no vigésimo ano de Jotão, filho de Uzias.

verses.original: וְיֶ֥תֶר דִּבְרֵי־ פֶ֖קַח וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê- p̄e·qaḥ wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Pekah along with all his accomplishments . . . they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Peca e tudo o que ele fez, eis que estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel.

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְפֶ֥קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ יוֹתָ֥ם בֶּן־ עֻזִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šə·ta·yim lə·p̄e·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl mā·laḵ yō·w·ṯām ben- ‘u·zî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the second year of the reign of Pekah son of Remaliah over Israel Jotham son of Uzziah became king . . . of Judah
verses.literalPt: No segundo ano de Peca, filho de Remalias, rei de Israel, começou a reinar Jotão, filho de Uzias, rei de Judá.

verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְרוּשָׁ֖א בַּת־ צָדֽוֹק׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ‘eś·rîm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh hā·yāh ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw wə·šêš- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw yə·rū·šā baṯ- ṣā·ḏō·wq
verses.literal: He was twenty-five . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen . . . years His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok
verses.literalPt: Ele tinha vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar e reinou dezesseis anos em Jerusalém. Sua mãe chamava-se Jerusa, filha de Zadoque.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֛ה עֻזִיָּ֥הוּ אָבִ֖יו עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ‘u·zî·yā·hū ’ā·ḇîw ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD just as his father . . . Uzziah had done
verses.literalPt: Ele fez o que era reto aos olhos de Jeová e procedeu em tudo como tinha feito seu pai Uzias.

verses.original: רַ֤ק הַבָּמוֹת֙ לֹ֣א סָ֔רוּ ע֗וֹד הָעָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמ֑וֹת ה֗וּא בָּנָ֛ה אֶת־ שַׁ֥עַר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה הָעֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: raq hab·bā·mō·wṯ lō sā·rū ‘ō·wḏ hā·‘ām mə·zab·bə·ḥîm ū·mə·qaṭ·ṭə·rîm bab·bā·mō·wṯ hū bā·nāh ’eṯ- ša·‘ar bêṯ- Yah·weh hā·‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: Nevertheless the high places were not taken away the people continued sacrificing and burning incense there Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Contudo, os altos não foram tirados; o povo ainda oferecia sacrifício e queimava incenso nos altos. Ele edificou a Porta Superior da Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יוֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yō·w·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jotham along with his accomplishments . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Jotão e tudo o que ele fez não estão, porventura, escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Judá?

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם הֵחֵ֣ל יְהוָ֗ה לְהַשְׁלִ֙יחַ֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה רְצִ֖ין מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וְאֵ֖ת פֶּ֥קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm hê·ḥêl Yah·weh lə·haš·lî·aḥ bî·hū·ḏāh rə·ṣîn me·leḵ ’ă·rām wə·’êṯ pe·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū
verses.literal: In those days the LORD began to send Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias, começou Jeová a enviar contra Judá a Rezim, rei da Síria, e a Peca, filho de Remalias.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹתָם֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵר֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו בְּעִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ yō·w·ṯām ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·‘îr dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw way·yim·lōḵ ’ā·ḥāz bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Jotham rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David his father And his son Ahaz reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Adormeceu Jotão com seus pais e foi sepultado com eles na Cidade de Davi, seu pai. Em seu lugar, reinou seu filho Acaz.
